rows.name: UCook Hawaiʻi
rows.description: Cooking sauces and marinades from fresh, whole ingredients
rows.notes: Own shop currently lists Kaʻū Orange, Lemongrass and Garlic sauces/marinades (12 oz $11.00; 64 oz $37.00; Island Trio $30.00); the pages carry no date. The retailer Pop-Up Mākeke also lists the brand as 'uCook Hawaiʻi' and says it is located on Oʻahu; it is the source for the Instagram and Facebook handles (links built from those handles). The 2025 Made in Hawaiʻi Festival listing (Honolulu Magazine, booth 2526, from Oʻahu) also named Lemongrass Party Chex, fudge brownies, lemongrass sweet-ish pickle chips and boiled peanuts; those are not on the current shop so are left out of products. The 2026 festival (Aug 20–23) vendor list was not found, so 2026 attendance is unconfirmed. A May 1, 2026 ChefZone sampling noted in earlier research was not re-verified. The own site spells the name 'uCook Hawaii'; the name is kept as given. No fixed location or regular market days stated. Own site shows an active online shop, hence still_active true.

markets.usual_days: 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, 9 AM–1 PM

rows.notes: The market's own directory lists 808 Mang Jeff Farm (Jeffrey Jose) at Kunia Loa Ridge Farm, with a number '94' that may be a lot number. The page states no products (N/A), has no date and no sales schedule, so activity is not confirmed and still_active is null. The market itself is active: the market and farmlands sites list the first and third Saturdays, 9 AM–1 PM, at 94-1100 Kunia Rd, Royal Kunia, Waipahu, with the next market on Sat Nov 7. The farmlands events page also lists some Friday dates in Dec 2026–2027, which conflicts with the Saturday schedule; check before publishing. The market address is not the farm's address, so address is null. No own site, social account or public phone found.

rows.name: From Scratch

rows.source_label: a HI Now Daily story sponsored by FarmLovers Markets
rows.notes: The July 2025 story names the Instagram handle @fromscratch808 and calls the business 'From Scratch 808'; it names the Ginger Turmeric shot as the top seller. It lists FarmLovers markets at Kakaʻako, Pearlridge and Kailua Town under a Saturday 8AM–12PM heading but does not say which one this vendor attends. The current FarmLovers site shows Saturdays 8AM–12PM at Kakaʻako and Pearlridge and Sundays 8AM–12PM at Kailua, so the story's Saturday heading conflicts for Kailua. Usual days are left null for that reason. No current vendor list, own site or recent post was found; active as of July 2025, current status unconfirmed.

rows.source_label: their own website (contact, shop and About pages)
rows.notes: The earlier gallery-page check missed that their own contact page states the Kaneohe address, phone 808-561-8997, and hours (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–2pm, Sun closed); treat the address as a contact address, not a walk-in shop. The shop page lists products at $9 per bag, $50 cookie trays, and $58–$60 cream cheese pies; the pages carry a 2020 copyright. The About page lists Koko Marina Craft Fair every 3rd Saturday, HPH gift shops (Straub, Pali Momi, Kapiolani), and Hawaii Holiday Craft and Gift Fairs and the Made in Hawaiʻi Festival; the Koko Marina day is undated and an organizer guide listed that market on the fourth Saturday, so check it. The fair organizer's own December 2025 vendor list names them, and KHON2 (Oct 26, 2026) says they are at the Oct 30–Nov 1, 2026 fair. The state business registry (downloaded Jan 1, 2026) shows the LLC as Active. The 2026 Made in Hawaiʻi Festival list was not found. No social links found.
